title: (0Day) Microsoft Visual Studio Link Following Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Microsoft Visual Studio. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Visual Studio installer. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the installer to overwrite a file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
